comparison.objective: Candidate calibrates and locks an articulated gripper stop; PR-1694 rolls puff pastry into a uniformly thick, sufficiently long sheet.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine tool seating and rotational counterholding; PR-1694 requires level rolling-pin control across deformable material over repeated passes.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained 90° opening through three cycles; PR-1694 grades sheet length, thickness distribution/evenness, damage and released pin placement. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Deformable thickness control with a spacer-ring rolling pin is a different tested ability from coupled screw-and-jam-nut calibration.
